translations.literal: When his term ended and he returned, the campaign against Taiyuan was underway; summoned to the emperor's camp, he was made Compiler and Drafter of the Historiography Institute, with added Left Remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from his post during the Taiyuan campaign, he was summoned to the emperor's camp, made a compiler and drafter of the Historiography Institute, and given the added title of left remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 五年，親拜左補闕、知制誥。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was personally appointed Left Supplementation Censor and Document Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was personally appointed left supplementation censor and document drafter.

sentences.zh: 初，龜圖多內寵，與妻劉氏不睦，並蒙正出之，頗淪躓窘乏，劉誓不復嫁。

translations.literal: At first Qitu had many favored concubines and was not harmonious with his wife Lady Liu; both expelled Mengzheng, and he fell into hardship and want; Liu swore never to remarry.
translations.idiomatic: At first Qitu had kept many concubines and quarreled with his wife Lady Liu; both cast Mengzheng out, and he knew poverty and hardship; Liu swore never to remarry.

sentences.zh: 及蒙正登仕，迎二親，同堂異室，奉養備至。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng entered office, he welcomed both parents; they shared one hall but separate chambers, and he supported them with full provision.
translations.idiomatic: Once Mengzheng rose in office he welcomed both parents home; they shared one hall in separate chambers, and he supported them with every care.

sentences.zh: 龜圖旋卒，詔起復。

translations.literal: Qitu soon died; an order granted leave from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Qitu soon died; the throne ordered him to resume office without completing mourning.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷都官郎中，入為翰林學士，擢左諫議大夫、參知政事，賜第麗景門。

translations.literal: Before long he was Ministry of Personnel director, entered as Hanlin academician, promoted to Left Remonstrance Grand Master and Vice Councilor, and was given a mansion at Lijing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he became director of the Ministry of Personnel, entered the Hanlin Academy, was promoted to left remonstrance grand master and vice councilor, and was given a mansion at Lijing Gate.

sentences.zh: 上謂之曰：「凡士未達，見當世之務戾於理者，則怏怏於心；

translations.literal: The emperor said to him: "Whenever a gentleman has not yet advanced, seeing affairs of the age at odds with reason, he is resentful in heart;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him, "Before a gentleman has risen, he broods over every affair of the age that runs against reason;

sentences.zh: 及列於位，得以獻可替否，當盡其所蘊，雖言未必盡中，亦當僉議而更之，俾協於道。

translations.literal: When he takes his place, able to offer what is acceptable and replace what is not, he should exhaust what he harbors; though words may not all hit the mark, the assembly should discuss and revise them to bring them into accord with the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Once in office he should offer what is sound and reject what is not, and bring forth all he has stored; even if his words do not all strike true, the court should debate and amend them until they accord with the Way.

sentences.zh: 朕固不以崇高自恃，使人不敢言也。

translations.literal: I certainly do not rely on exalted height to make others dare not speak."
translations.idiomatic: I certainly do not stand on my eminence and silence those who would speak."

sentences.zh: 」蒙正初入朝堂，有朝士指之曰：「此子亦參政耶？

translations.literal: " When Mengzheng first entered the court hall, a court gentleman pointed at him and said: "This fellow is also a councilor?
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng first entered the court hall, a court gentleman pointed at him and said, "This fellow is a councilor too?

sentences.zh: 」蒙正陽為不聞而過之，同列不能平，詰其姓名，蒙正遽止之曰：「若一知其姓名，則終身不能忘，不若毋知之為愈也。

translations.literal: " Mengzheng pretended not to hear and passed by; his colleagues could not be at peace and questioned the man's name; Mengzheng hastily stopped them and said: "If you once know a man's name, you can never forget it for life; better not to know at all."
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng feigned not to hear and walked on; his colleagues could not contain themselves and demanded the man's name; Mengzheng quickly stopped them and said, "Once you know a man's name you never forget it for life; better never to know at all."

sentences.zh: 」時皆服其量。

translations.literal: " At the time all admired his magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: All present admired his forbearance.

sentences.zh: 李昉罷相，蒙正拜中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事，監修國史。

translations.literal: When Li Fang was dismissed as chief councilor, Mengzheng was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Chief Councilor, overseeing the national history.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Fang left the chief councilorship, Mengzheng was made vice director of the Secretariat, concurrent minister of revenue, and chief councilor, with charge of the national history.

sentences.zh: 蒙正質厚寬簡，有重望，以正道自持。

translations.literal: Mengzheng was plain, thick, broad, and simple, with heavy prestige, holding himself to the upright Way.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng was plain, steady, and broad-minded, commanded deep respect, and held himself to the upright path.

sentences.zh: 遇事敢言，每論時政，有未允者，必固稱不可，上嘉其無隱。

translations.literal: When matters arose he dared speak; whenever he discussed current policy, if something was not acceptable he firmly said it could not be done; the emperor praised his lack of concealment.
translations.idiomatic: He spoke boldly whenever affairs arose; in every discussion of policy, if something seemed wrong he firmly said it could not stand, and the emperor praised his candor.

sentences.zh: 趙普開國元老，蒙正後進，歷官一紀，遂同相位，普甚推許之。

translations.literal: Zhao Pu was a founding elder of the state; Mengzheng came later, and after a full cycle of offices they shared the same rank; Pu greatly praised and supported him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Pu was a founding elder of the dynasty; Mengzheng came later, yet after a full cycle of offices they shared the chief councilorship, and Pu greatly esteemed him.

sentences.zh: 俄丁內艱，起復。

translations.literal: Soon he mourned his mother; leave from mourning was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He soon mourned his mother; the throne granted leave from mourning.

sentences.zh: 先是，盧多遜為相，其子雍起家即授水部員外郎，後遂以為常。

translations.literal: Previously, when Lu Duosun was chief councilor, his son Yong upon entering office was at once made Vice Director of the Water Bureau; afterward this became customary.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Lu Duosun was chief councilor, his son Yong upon entering office had immediately been made vice director of the water bureau, and that had since become custom.

sentences.zh: 至是，蒙正奏曰：「臣忝甲科及第，釋褐止授九品京官。

translations.literal: Now Mengzheng memorialized saying: "Your servant humbly received first rank in the jinshi examination; upon leaving student robes I was granted only a ninth-rank capital post.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng now memorialized, "Your servant took first place in the jinshi examination; upon leaving student robes I received only a ninth-rank capital post.

sentences.zh: 況天下才能，老於巖穴，不霑寸祿者多矣。

translations.literal: Moreover throughout the realm men of talent old in mountain caves, not touching an inch of salary, are many.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, throughout the realm men of talent who have grown old in reclusion without a scrap of salary are countless.

sentences.zh: 今臣男始離襁褓，膺此寵命，恐罹陰譴，乞以臣釋褐時官補之。

translations.literal: Now your servant's son has just left the swaddling clothes and receives this favoring mandate; I fear incurring hidden reproach and beg that he be given the post your servant received upon leaving student robes."
translations.idiomatic: Now my son has just left the swaddling clothes and receives this favored appointment; I fear hidden reproach and beg that he receive the post I held when I first left student robes."

sentences.zh: 」自是宰相子止授九品京官，遂為定制。

translations.literal: " From then on chief councilors' sons were granted only ninth-rank capital posts, and this became a fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter chief councilors' sons received only ninth-rank capital posts, and the rule became permanent.

sentences.zh: 朝士有藏古鏡者，自言能照二百里，欲獻之蒙正以求知。

translations.literal: A court gentleman had an antique mirror and claimed it could illuminate two hundred li, wishing to present it to Mengzheng to gain acquaintance.
translations.idiomatic: A court gentleman owned an antique mirror and claimed it could see two hundred li, hoping to present it to Mengzheng and win his notice.

sentences.zh: 蒙正笑曰：「吾面不過楪子大，安用照二百里哉？

translations.literal: Mengzheng laughed and said: "My face is no larger than a small plate—what use is illuminating two hundred li?
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng laughed and said, "My face is no larger than a dinner plate—what need have I to see two hundred li?

sentences.zh: 」聞者歎服。

translations.literal: " Hearers sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Those who heard it sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，左正言宋沆上疏忤旨，沆，蒙正妻族，坐是罷為吏部尚書，復相李昉。

translations.literal: In the Chunhua era, Left Rectifier Song Hang submitted a memorial that offended the emperor; Hang was Mengzheng's wife's kin, and for this Mengzheng was dismissed as Minister of Personnel and Li Fang was again made chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chunhua era left rectifier Song Hang submitted a memorial that offended the emperor; Hang was kin to Mengzheng's wife, and for this Mengzheng was dismissed as minister of personnel while Li Fang was again made chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 四年，昉罷，蒙正復以本官入相。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Fang was dismissed and Mengzheng again entered as chief councilor with his former title.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Fang left office and Mengzheng again entered as chief councilor under his former title.

sentences.zh: 因對，論及征伐，上曰：「朕比來征討，蓋為民除暴，苟好功黷武，則天下之人熸亡盡矣。

translations.literal: In audience they discussed campaigns; the emperor said: "My campaigns of late are to remove violence for the people; if one loves achievement and abuses arms, then the people of the realm will be extinguished to the last."
translations.idiomatic: In audience they discussed warfare; the emperor said, "My recent campaigns have been to rid the people of tyranny; if one loves achievement and abuses arms, the people of the realm will perish to the last man."

sentences.zh: 」蒙正對曰：「隋、唐數十年中，四征遼碣，人不堪命。

translations.literal: Mengzheng replied: "Within several decades of Sui and Tang, they campaigned four times against Liaodong; the people could not bear their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng replied, "Across several decades Sui and Tang campaigned four times against Liaodong, and the people could not endure the burden.

sentences.zh: 煬帝全軍陷沒，太宗自運土木攻城，如此卒無所濟。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang's entire army was lost; Emperor Taizong himself transported earth and wood to attack cities—yet in the end nothing was achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang lost his entire army; Emperor Taizong himself hauled earth and timber to besiege cities—yet in the end nothing was gained.

sentences.zh: 且治國之要，在內修政事，則遠人來歸，自致安靜。

translations.literal: Moreover the essentials of governing a state lie in cultivating government within; then distant men come to submit of themselves and quiet is attained of itself.
translations.idiomatic: The essentials of governing a state lie in strengthening government at home; then distant peoples come of themselves and peace follows without force.

sentences.zh: 」上韙之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words.

sentences.zh: 嘗燈夕設宴，蒙正侍，上語之曰：「五代之際，生靈凋喪，周太祖自鄴南歸，士庶皆罹剽掠，下則火災，上則彗孛，觀者恐懼，當時謂無復太平之日矣。

translations.literal: Once at a Lantern Festival banquet Mengzheng attended; the emperor said to him: "In the Five Dynasties era the living were withered and lost; when Zhou Taizu returned south from Ye, scholars and commoners all suffered plunder; below there were fires, above there were comets; observers were fearful, and at the time they said there would never again be days of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Once at a Lantern Festival banquet Mengzheng attended, the emperor told him, "In the Five Dynasties the people were wasted away; when Zhou Taizu returned south from Ye, scholars and commoners alike were plundered; fires raged below and comets above; onlookers trembled, and many said peace would never return.

sentences.zh: 朕躬覽庶政，萬事粗理，每念上天之貺，致此繁盛，乃知理亂在人。

translations.literal: I personally oversee the myriad affairs; all matters are roughly ordered; whenever I think of Heaven's gift, bringing this flourishing age, I then know that order and disorder lie in men.
translations.idiomatic: I myself oversee the myriad affairs and all is roughly in order; whenever I reflect on Heaven's gift that has brought this flourishing age, I know that order and disorder lie in men.

sentences.zh: 」蒙正避席曰：「乘輿所在，士庶走集，故繁盛如此。

translations.literal: " Mengzheng left his mat and said: "Where the imperial carriage is, scholars and commoners gather, and therefore it is flourishing thus.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng rose from his mat and said, "Where the imperial carriage stands, scholars and commoners gather, and so the capital looks flourishing.

sentences.zh: 臣嘗見都城外不數里，饑寒而死者甚眾，不必盡然。

translations.literal: Your servant has seen not a few li beyond the capital wall where the hungry and cold die in great numbers; it is not entirely so.
translations.idiomatic: I have seen, not many li beyond the capital wall, the hungry and cold dying in great numbers; it is not all as you say.

sentences.zh: 願陛下視近以及遠，蒼生之幸也。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty to regard what is near and extend to what is far—the good fortune of the living multitude.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to look from what is near to what is far—that is the fortune of the common people.

sentences.zh: 」上變色不言。

translations.literal: " The emperor changed color and did not speak.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's face changed and he fell silent.

sentences.zh: 蒙正侃然復位，同列多其直諒。

translations.literal: Mengzheng calmly returned to his place; colleagues admired his directness.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng calmly resumed his seat; his colleagues admired his blunt honesty.

sentences.zh: 上嘗欲遣人使朔方，諭中書選才而可責以事者，蒙正退以名上，上不許。

translations.literal: The emperor once wished to send someone to Shuo Prefecture and told the Secretariat to select talent on whom affairs could be charged; Mengzheng withdrew and submitted a name; the emperor did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once wished to send an envoy to Shuo Prefecture and told the Secretariat to choose someone capable of bearing responsibility; Mengzheng withdrew and submitted a name; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 他日，三問，三以其人對。

translations.literal: Another day he asked three times; three times he answered with the same man.
translations.idiomatic: On another day he asked three times; three times Mengzheng named the same man.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿何執耶？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Why are you so obstinate?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Why are you so stubborn?

sentences.zh: 」蒙正曰：「臣非執，蓋陛下未諒爾。

translations.literal: " Mengzheng said: "Your servant is not obstinate—the Majesty simply has not yet understood.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng said, "I am not stubborn—Your Majesty simply has not yet understood.

sentences.zh: 」 固稱：「其人可使，餘人不及。

translations.literal: " He firmly said: "This man can be sent; no one else equals him.
translations.idiomatic: He insisted, "This man can be sent; no one else equals him.

sentences.zh: 臣不欲用媚道妄隨人主意，以害國事。

translations.literal: Your servant does not wish to use flattery to follow others' intentions at random and harm state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: I do not wish to use flattery and follow others' whims at the cost of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 」同列悚息不敢動。

translations.literal: " Colleagues held their breath and dared not move.
translations.idiomatic: His colleagues held their breath and dared not stir.

sentences.zh: 上退謂左右曰：「蒙正氣量，我不如。

translations.literal: The emperor withdrew and said to attendants: "Mengzheng's magnanimity—I am not his equal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor withdrew and told his attendants, "Mengzheng's magnanimity—I am not his equal.

sentences.zh: 」既而卒用蒙正所薦，果稱職。

translations.literal: " Soon afterward he used the man Mengzheng had recommended, who indeed proved competent.
translations.idiomatic: He soon used the man Mengzheng had recommended, who indeed proved competent.

sentences.zh: 至道初，以右僕射出判河南府兼西京留守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhidao he was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and sent out to judge Henan Prefecture, concurrently Western Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhidao he was made right vice director of the Secretariat and sent out to judge Henan Prefecture, concurrently regent of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 蒙正至洛，多引親舊歡宴，政尚寬靜，委任僚屬，事多總裁而已。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng reached Luoyang he frequently gathered kin and old friends in merry feasts; his government favored leniency and quiet; he entrusted affairs to subordinates and mostly only made final decisions.
translations.idiomatic: At Luoyang he often gathered kin and old friends for feasts; his government favored leniency and ease; he entrusted affairs to subordinates and reserved final decisions to himself.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，進左僕射。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong succeeded the throne, he was promoted to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenzong succeeded the throne, Mengzheng was promoted to left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 會營奉熙陵，蒙正追感先朝不次之遇，奉家財三百餘萬以助用。

translations.literal: When the Yongxi Mausoleum was being built, Mengzheng, moved by the former court's extraordinary favor, presented more than three million in family wealth to assist the work.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongxi Mausoleum was being built, moved by the former court's extraordinary favor, he presented more than three million from his family wealth to help fund the work.

sentences.zh: 葬日，伏哭盡哀，人以為得大臣體。

translations.literal: On the burial day he prostrated himself and wept to exhaustion; people held that he showed a great minister's bearing.
translations.idiomatic: On the burial day he prostrated himself and wept until spent; observers said he had shown a great minister's bearing.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，以本官同平章事、昭文館大學士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianping he was made chief councilor with his former title and Grand Academician of the Zhaowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianping he was again made chief councilor under his former title and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall.

sentences.zh: 國朝以來三入相者，惟趙普與蒙正焉。

translations.literal: Since the founding of the dynasty only Zhao Pu and Mengzheng had entered the chief councilorship three times.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the dynasty only Zhao Pu and Mengzheng had thrice entered the chief councilorship.

sentences.zh: 郊祀禮成，加司空兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: When the suburban sacrifice rites were completed, he was given concurrent Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Department of State.
translations.idiomatic: When the suburban sacrifice was completed, he was given concurrent minister of works and vice director of the Department of State.

sentences.zh: 六年，授太子太師，封萊國公，改封徐，又封許。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, enfeoffed as Duke of Lai, changed to Xu, then again enfeoffed as Duke of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made grand preceptor of the heir apparent, enfeoffed as Duke of Lai, then given the Xu fief, and finally enfeoffed as Duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 景德二年春，表請歸洛。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Jingde he memorialized asking to return to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Jingde he memorialized asking to retire to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 陛辭日，肩輿至東園門，命二子掖以升殿，因言：「遠人請和，弭兵省財，古今上策，惟願陛下以百姓為念。

translations.literal: On the day of court farewell he was carried in a shoulder chair to the Eastern Garden Gate; he ordered his two sons to support him up the hall, and said: "The distant peoples seek peace; to still arms and save wealth is the supreme strategy of past and present—I only wish Your Majesty to take the common people to heart.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of his farewell audience he was carried in a sedan to the Eastern Garden Gate and had his two sons help him up the hall, saying, "The distant peoples seek peace; to still arms and save wealth is the supreme strategy of every age—I only beg Your Majesty to keep the common people in mind.

sentences.zh: 」上嘉納之，因遷從簡太子洗馬，知簡奉禮郎。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted it; he therefore promoted Congjian to Crown Prince study companion and Zhi to Court Gentleman for Offering.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted this; he therefore promoted Congjian to crown prince study companion and Zhi to court gentleman for offering.

sentences.zh: 蒙正至洛，有園亭花木，日與親舊宴會，子孫環列，迭奉壽觴，怡然自得。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng reached Luoyang he had gardens, pavilions, flowers, and trees; daily he feasted with kin and old friends; sons and grandsons ranged about him, passing cups in turn, content and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: At Luoyang he had gardens, pavilions, flowers, and trees; day after day he feasted with kin and old friends while sons and grandsons ranged about him, passing cups in turn, content and at ease.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符而後，上朝永熙陵，封泰山，祠后土，過洛，兩幸其第，錫賚有加。

translations.literal: After Dazhong xiangfu he attended court at the Yongxi Mausoleum, performed the Feng and Fen sacrifices, and passed through Luoyang; twice the emperor visited his residence and bestowed gifts in addition.
translations.idiomatic: After Dazhong xiangfu he attended court at the Yongxi Mausoleum, performed the Feng and Fen sacrifices, and passed through Luoyang; twice the emperor visited his home and heaped gifts upon him.

sentences.zh: 上謂蒙正曰：「卿諸子孰可用？

translations.literal: The emperor said to Mengzheng: "Among your sons, which can be used?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Mengzheng, "Which of your sons can be put to use?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「諸子皆不足用。

translations.literal: " He replied: "None of the sons is adequate.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "None of my sons is adequate.

sentences.zh: 有侄夷簡，任潁州推官，宰相才也。

translations.literal: There is a nephew Yijian, serving as investigating commissioner in Yingzhou—talent for chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: I have a nephew Yijian, investigating commissioner in Yingzhou—he has the talent of a chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 」夷簡由是見知於上。

translations.literal: " Yijian thereby came to the emperor's notice.
translations.idiomatic: Yijian thereby came to the emperor's notice.

sentences.zh: 富言者，蒙正客也。

translations.literal: Fu Yan was Mengzheng's guest.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yan was Mengzheng's guest.

sentences.zh: 一日白曰：「兒子十許歲，欲令入書院，事廷評、太祝。

translations.literal: One day he reported: "My son of about ten years wishes to enter the academy to serve as reviewing censor and court gentleman for offering.
translations.idiomatic: One day he reported, "My son of about ten years wishes to enter the academy to study for the posts of reviewing censor and court gentleman for offering.

sentences.zh: 」蒙正許之。

translations.literal: Mengzheng consented.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng agreed.

sentences.zh: 及見，驚曰：「此兒他日名位與吾相似，而勳業遠過於吾。

translations.literal: When he saw the boy he was startled and said: "This boy's name and rank in later days will resemble mine, yet his achievements will far surpass mine.
translations.idiomatic: When he saw the boy he was startled and said, "This boy's later name and rank will resemble mine, yet his achievements will far surpass mine.

sentences.zh: 」令與諸子同學，供給甚厚。

translations.literal: " He ordered him to study with his sons and supplied him generously.
translations.idiomatic: He had him study with his sons and supplied him generously.

sentences.zh: 言之子，即弼也。

translations.literal: Yan's son was none other than Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's son was none other than Bi.

sentences.zh: 後弼兩入相，亦以司徒致仕。

translations.literal: Later Bi twice entered the chief councilorship and also retired as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Later Bi twice entered the chief councilorship and likewise retired as minister of works.

sentences.zh: 其知人類如此。

translations.literal: His knowledge of men was of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: His judgment of men was of this sort.

sentences.zh: 許國之命甫下而卒，年六十八。

translations.literal: The order enfeoffing him Duke of Xu had just been issued when he died, aged sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: The order enfeoffing him as Duke of Xu had just been issued when he died, aged sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈中書令，諡曰文穆。

translations.literal: Posthumously made Vice Director of the Secretariat; posthumous title Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made vice director of the Secretariat, with the posthumous title Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 蒙正初為相時，張紳知蔡州，坐贓免。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng first became chief councilor, Zhang Shen governed Caizhou and was dismissed for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng first became chief councilor, Zhang Shen governed Caizhou and was dismissed for corruption.

sentences.zh: 或言於上曰：「紳家富，不至此，特蒙正貧時勾索不如意，今報之爾。

translations.literal: Someone said to the emperor: "Shen's family is wealthy and would not come to this—it is only that when Mengzheng was poor, Shen pressed him unsatisfactorily, and now he repays it.
translations.idiomatic: Someone told the emperor, "Shen's family is wealthy and would not stoop to this—it is only that when Mengzheng was poor, Shen pressed him harshly, and now he repays the old score.

sentences.zh: 」上命即復紳官，蒙正不辯。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered Shen's office restored at once; Mengzheng did not argue.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at once restored Shen to office; Mengzheng did not argue.

sentences.zh: 後考課院得紳實狀，復黜為絳州團練副使。

translations.literal: Later the Performance Review Bureau obtained Shen's true circumstances and again demoted him to military training vice commissioner of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Performance Review Bureau obtained Shen's true circumstances and again demoted him to military training vice commissioner of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 及蒙正再入相，太宗謂曰：「張紳果有贓。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng again entered as chief councilor, Taizong said: "Zhang Shen truly had corruption."
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng again entered as chief councilor, Taizong said, "Zhang Shen truly was corrupt."

sentences.zh: 」蒙正不辯亦不謝。

translations.literal: Mengzheng did not argue and did not thank.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng neither argued nor thanked.

sentences.zh: 在西京日，上數遣中貴人將命至，蒙正待之如在相位時，不少貶，時人重焉。

translations.literal: During his days in the Western Capital the emperor several times sent palace eunuchs bearing orders; Mengzheng received them as when he had been in the chief councilor's rank, not diminishing in the least; men of the time respected this.
translations.idiomatic: During his years in the Western Capital the emperor several times sent palace eunuchs with orders; Mengzheng received them with the same ceremony as when he had held the chief councilorship, not diminishing himself in the least, and men of the time respected him for it.

sentences.zh: 子從簡，再為國子博士；

translations.literal: His son Cong Jian again served as Director of Studies at the Imperial Academy;
translations.idiomatic: His son Cong Jian again served as Director of Studies at the Imperial Academy;

sentences.zh: 惟簡，太子中舍；

translations.literal: Wei Jian, Attendant in the Heir Apparent's Household;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jian served as Attendant in the Heir Apparent's Household;

sentences.zh: 承簡，司門員外郎；

translations.literal: Cheng Jian, Vice Director of the Gate Office;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Jian was Vice Director of the Gate Office;

sentences.zh: 行簡，比部員外郎；

translations.literal: Xing Jian, Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jian was Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 務簡，亦國子博士；

translations.literal: Wu Jian, also Director of Studies at the Imperial Academy;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jian also served as Director of Studies at the Imperial Academy;

sentences.zh: 居簡，殿中丞；

translations.literal: Ju Jian, Assistant Director of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian was Assistant Director of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 知簡，太子右讚善大夫。

translations.literal: Zhi Jian, Right Assistant to the Heir Apparent for Good Conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi Jian was Right Assistant to the Heir Apparent for Good Conduct.

sentences.zh: 蒙正弟蒙休，咸平進士，至殿中丞。

translations.literal: Mengzheng's younger brother Meng Xiu, a Xianping advanced scholar, rose to Assistant Director of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng's younger brother Meng Xiu, a Xianping advanced scholar, rose to Assistant Director of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 龜圖弟龜祥，殿中丞、知壽州。

translations.literal: Gui Xiang, younger brother of Gui Tu, Assistant Director of the Palace Secretariat and prefect of Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Tu's younger brother Gui Xiang served as Assistant Director of the Palace Secretariat and prefect of Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 子蒙亨，舉進士高等，既廷試，以蒙正居中書，故報罷。

translations.literal: His son Meng Heng placed high in the metropolitan examination; after the palace examination, because Mengzheng held the Central Secretariat, the result was reported void.
translations.idiomatic: His son Meng Heng ranked high in the metropolitan examination, but after the palace examination his result was voided because Mengzheng held the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 後歷下蔡、武平主簿。

translations.literal: Later he served successively as registrar of Xia Cai and Wuping.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as registrar of Xia Cai and Wuping.

sentences.zh: 至道初，考課州縣官，蒙亨引對，文學、政事俱優，命為光祿寺丞，改大理寺丞，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, when prefectural and county officials were evaluated, Meng Heng was presented at court; his literary and administrative merits were both excellent. He was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, then transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, and died.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, when prefectural and county officials were evaluated, Meng Heng was presented at court. His literary and administrative merits were both excellent. He was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, then transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, and died.

sentences.zh: 次子蒙巽，虞部員外郎；

translations.literal: His second son Meng Xi, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works;
translations.idiomatic: His second son Meng Xi was Vice Director of the Ministry of Works;

sentences.zh: 蒙周，淳化進士及第。

translations.literal: Meng Zhou, a Chunhua advanced scholar.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhou was a Chunhua advanced scholar.

sentences.zh: 蒙亨子即夷簡也。

translations.literal: Meng Heng's son was none other than Yijian.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Heng's son was none other than Yijian.

sentences.zh: 次子宗簡，亦進士及第。

translations.literal: His second son Zong Jian also passed the advanced examination.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Zong Jian also passed the advanced examination.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，居簡提點京東刑獄，時夏竦有憾於石介，介死，竦言於上曰：「介未嘗死，北走鄰國矣。

translations.literal: During the Qingli era, Ju Jian served as judicial intendant of the Jingdong Circuit. At that time Xia Song bore a grudge against Shi Jie. After Jie died, Song said to the emperor: "Jie did not in fact die; he has fled north to a neighboring state.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingli era, Ju Jian served as judicial intendant of the Jingdong Circuit. At that time Xia Song bore a grudge against Shi Jie. After Jie died, Song told the emperor, "Jie did not in fact die; he has fled north to a neighboring state.

sentences.zh: 」乃遣中使發棺驗之。

translations.literal: " The court then sent a palace envoy to open the coffin and verify.
translations.idiomatic: " The court then sent a palace envoy to open the coffin and verify.

sentences.zh: 居簡謂曰：「萬一介果死，則朝廷為無故發人之墓，奈何？

translations.literal: Ju Jian said to him: "In the event Jie truly is dead, then the court will have opened a man's tomb without cause—what then?
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian said to him, "If Jie truly is dead, the court will have opened a man's tomb without cause. What then?

sentences.zh: 」中使曰：「於君何如？

translations.literal: " The envoy said: "What of it for you?
translations.idiomatic: " The envoy said, "What is that to you?

sentences.zh: 」居簡曰：「介死，當時必有內外親族及門生會葬，問之可也。

translations.literal: " Ju Jian said: "If Jie is dead, there must at the time have been kinsmen within and without and students who attended the burial; they may be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: " Ju Jian said, "If Jie is dead, kinsmen and students must have attended the burial at the time. They can be questioned.

sentences.zh: 」中使乃令結狀保證以聞，介事乃白。

translations.literal: " The envoy then had bonds of guarantee drawn up and reported; the matter of Jie was thereby clarified.
translations.idiomatic: " The envoy then required written guarantees before reporting, and the matter of Jie was clarified.

sentences.zh: 居簡長者，其行事多類此。

translations.literal: Ju Jian was a man of mature judgment; much of his conduct was of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian was a man of mature judgment, and much of his conduct was of this kind.

sentences.zh: 徐州妖人孔直溫挾左道誘軍士為變，或詣轉運使告，不受詞。

translations.literal: At Xuzhou the sorcerer Kong Zhiwen relied on heterodox arts to entice soldiers into rebellion; some went to the transport commissioner to report it, but he would not accept the complaint.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuzhou the sorcerer Kong Zhiwen used heterodox arts to entice soldiers into rebellion. Some reported it to the transport commissioner, but he would not accept the complaint.

sentences.zh: 居簡令易其牒，盡捕究黨與，貸詿誤者，請於朝，斬直溫等。

translations.literal: Ju Jian had the document altered, arrested and investigated the whole clique, pardoned those misled in error, and requested of the court that Zhiwen and the rest be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian had the document altered, arrested and investigated the whole clique, pardoned those misled in error, and asked the court to execute Zhiwen and the rest.

sentences.zh: 濮州復叛，都民驚潰，居簡馳往，獲首惡誅之。

translations.literal: When Pu Prefecture rebelled again, the capital populace panicked and scattered; Ju Jian hurried there, seized the ringleaders, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: When Pu Prefecture rebelled again, the capital populace panicked and scattered. Ju Jian hurried there, seized the ringleaders, and executed them.

sentences.zh: 因大閱兵享勞，姦不得發。

translations.literal: He then held a great review of troops and feasted them in reward, so that treachery could not arise.
translations.idiomatic: He then held a great review of troops and feasted them in reward, so that treachery could not arise.

sentences.zh: 用二事，遷秩鹽鐵判官，拜集賢院學士、知梓州、應天府，徙荊南，進龍圖閣直學士、知廣州，陶甓甃城，人以為便。

translations.literal: For these two matters he was promoted to Salt and Iron Commissioner; he was appointed Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, prefect of Zi Prefecture and of Yingtian Prefecture, then transferred to Jingnan, advanced to Direct Academician of the Longtu Pavilion and prefect of Guang Prefecture, where he tiled the city walls with pottery bricks—people regarded this as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: For these two matters he was promoted to Salt and Iron Commissioner. He was appointed Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, prefect of Zi and Yingtian, then transferred to Jingnan and advanced to Direct Academician of the Longtu Pavilion and prefect of Guang Prefecture, where he tiled the city walls with pottery bricks, which people found convenient.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎判西京御史臺，卒，年七十二。

translations.literal: As Vice Minister of War he concurrently served as judge of the Western Capital Censorate; he died at seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: As Vice Minister of War he concurrently judged the Western Capital Censorate. He died at seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 張齊賢

translations.literal: Zhang Qixian
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qixian

sentences.zh: 張齊賢，曹州冤句人。

translations.literal: Zhang Qixian, a native of Yuanju in Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qixian was a native of Yuanju in Cao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 生三歲，值晉亂，徙家洛陽。

translations.literal: At three years of age he encountered the turmoil of Jin and his family moved to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At three he encountered the turmoil of Jin, and his family moved to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 孤貧力學，有遠志，慕唐李大亮之為人，故字師亮。

translations.literal: Orphaned and poor, he studied with effort and had far-reaching ambition; he admired Tang's Li Daliang as a man, and therefore took the style Shiliang.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned and poor, he studied with effort and harbored far-reaching ambition. He admired the Tang figure Li Daliang and therefore took the style Shiliang.

sentences.zh: 太祖幸西都，齊賢以布衣獻策馬前，召至行宮，齊賢以手畫地，條陳十事：曰下幷、汾、曰富民、曰封建、曰敦孝、曰舉賢、曰太學、曰籍田、曰選良吏、曰慎刑、曰懲姦。

translations.literal: When Taizu visited the Western Capital, Qixian as a commoner presented a strategy before his horse and was summoned to the traveling palace. Qixian traced on the ground with his hand and set forth ten items in order: namely, subduing Bing and Fen; enriching the people; enfeoffment; encouraging filial piety; elevating the worthy; the Imperial Academy; the ceremonial plowing field; selecting good officials; cautious punishments; and punishing wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu visited the Western Capital, Qixian presented a strategy before his horse as a commoner and was summoned to the traveling palace. He traced on the ground with his hand and set forth ten items in order: subduing Bing and Fen; enriching the people; enfeoffment; encouraging filial piety; elevating the worthy; the Imperial Academy; the ceremonial plowing field; selecting good officials; cautious punishments; and punishing wickedness.

sentences.zh: 內四說稱旨，齊賢堅執以為皆善，上怒，令武士拽出之。

translations.literal: Four of the proposals within pleased him, but Qixian insisted that all were good. The emperor grew angry and ordered armored guards to drag him out.
translations.idiomatic: Four of the proposals pleased him, but Qixian insisted that all were good. The emperor grew angry and ordered armored guards to drag him out.

sentences.zh: 及還，語太宗曰：「我幸西都，唯得一張齊賢爾。

translations.literal: On returning, he said to Taizong: "When I visited the Western Capital I gained only one Zhang Qixian.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he said to Taizong, "When I visited the Western Capital I gained only one Zhang Qixian.

sentences.zh: 我不欲爵之以官，異時可使輔汝為相也。」

translations.literal: I do not wish to ennoble him with office; in time he may be made to assist you as chief councilor."
translations.idiomatic: I do not wish to ennoble him with office now; in time he may assist you as chief councilor."

sentences.zh: 太宗擢進士，欲置齊賢高第，有司偶失掄選，上不悅，一榜盡與京官，於是齊賢以大理評事通判衡州。

translations.literal: Taizong elevated him as advanced scholar and wished to place Qixian in the highest rank, but the department by chance failed in the selection; the emperor was displeased and the entire list was given capital posts—thereupon Qixian became Evaluator of Matters at the Court of Judicial Review and concurrent prefectural judge of Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong elevated him as advanced scholar and wished to place Qixian in the highest rank, but the department by chance failed in the selection. The emperor was displeased and the entire list was given capital posts, and Qixian became Evaluator of Matters at the Court of Judicial Review and concurrent prefectural judge of Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時州鞫劫盜，論皆死，齊賢至，活其失入者五人。

translations.literal: At the time the prefecture was trying robbers, and all were sentenced to death. When Qixian arrived he spared five who had been wrongly convicted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the prefecture was trying robbers, and all were sentenced to death. When Qixian arrived he spared five who had been wrongly convicted.

sentences.zh: 自荊渚至桂州，水遞鋪夫數千戶，困於郵役，衣食多不給，論奏減其半。

translations.literal: From Jingzhu to Gui Prefecture, relay courier households numbered in the thousands; harried by postal service, food and clothing were often insufficient—he memorialized to reduce the burden by half.
translations.idiomatic: From Jingzhu to Gui Prefecture, relay courier households numbered in the thousands. Harried by postal service, they often lacked food and clothing, and he memorialized to reduce the burden by half.

sentences.zh: 四年，代還，會親征晉陽，齊賢上謁，遷秘書丞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he returned on replacement of office; he happened upon the emperor's personal campaign against Jinyang and, on presenting himself, was promoted to Secretary Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he returned on replacement of office, happened upon the emperor's personal campaign against Jinyang, and on presenting himself was promoted to Secretary Director.

sentences.zh: 忻州新下，命知州事。

translations.literal: Xin Prefecture had just been taken; he was ordered to manage prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Prefecture had just been taken, and he was ordered to manage prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 明年召還，改著作佐郎，直史館，改左拾遺。

translations.literal: The next year he was recalled, made Assistant Compiler, entered the Historiography Institute, and changed to Left Reminder.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was recalled, made Assistant Compiler, entered the Historiography Institute, and changed to Left Reminder.

sentences.zh: 冬，車駕北征，議者皆言宜速取幽薊，齊賢上疏曰：

translations.literal: In winter, when the imperial carriage campaigned north, the discussants all said the You-Ji region should be taken quickly. Qixian submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: In winter, when the imperial carriage campaigned north, the discussants all said the You-Ji region should be taken quickly. Qixian submitted a memorial that read:

sentences.zh: 「方今海內一家，朝野無事。

translations.literal: "At present within the seas there is one house, and court and countryside are without affairs.
translations.idiomatic: "At present within the seas there is one house, and court and countryside are without affairs.

sentences.zh: 關聖慮者，豈不以河東新平，屯兵尚眾，幽燕未下，輦運為勞？

translations.literal: What occupies the sage mind—is it not because Hedong has newly been pacified, garrison troops are still numerous, You and Ji are not yet taken, and transport by imperial carriage is laborious?
translations.idiomatic: What occupies the sage mind—is it not because Hedong has newly been pacified, garrison troops are still numerous, You and Ji are not yet taken, and transport by imperial carriage is laborious?

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為此不足慮也。

translations.literal: In your servant's foolish view this is not worth anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: In your servant's foolish view this is not worth anxiety.

sentences.zh: 自河東初下，臣知忻州，捕得契丹納米典吏，皆云自山後轉般以授河東。

translations.literal: Since Hedong was first taken, when your servant was prefect of Xin Prefecture he captured Khitan grain-supply clerks, all of whom said grain was transferred in relays from beyond the mountains to supply Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Since Hedong was first taken, when your servant was prefect of Xin Prefecture he captured Khitan grain-supply clerks, all of whom said grain was transferred in relays from beyond the mountains to supply Hedong.

sentences.zh: 以臣料，契丹能自備軍食，則於太原非不盡力，然終為我有者，力不足也。

translations.literal: By your servant's estimate, if the Khitan can supply their own army provisions, then toward Taiyuan they are not without effort—yet in the end it becomes ours because their strength is insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: By your servant's estimate, if the Khitan can supply their own army provisions, then toward Taiyuan they spare no effort—yet in the end it becomes ours because their strength is insufficient.

sentences.zh: 河東初平，人心未固，嵐、憲、忻、代未有軍砦，入寇則田牧頓失，擾邊則守備可虞。

translations.literal: Hedong has just been pacified and hearts are not yet firm; Lan, Xian, Xin, and Dai have no military forts. If they invade, field and pasture are suddenly lost; if the border is harassed, defense is to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong has just been pacified and hearts are not yet firm. Lan, Xian, Xin, and Dai have no military forts. If they invade, field and pasture are suddenly lost; if the border is harassed, defense is to be feared.

sentences.zh: 及國家守要害，增壁壘，左控右扼，疆事甚嚴，恩信已行，民心已定，乃於雁門陽武谷來爭小利，此其智力可料而知也。

translations.literal: When the state guards strategic points, adds walls and ramparts, controls left and restrains right, and frontier affairs are very strict, when favor and trust have been carried out and popular hearts are settled—then for them to come to Yanmen's Yangwu Valley to contend for small profit, this intelligence can be calculated and known.
translations.idiomatic: When the state guards strategic points, adds walls and ramparts, controls left and restrains right, and frontier affairs are very strict—when favor and trust have been carried out and popular hearts are settled—then for them to come to Yanmen's Yangwu Valley to contend for small profit, that intelligence can be calculated and known.

sentences.zh: 聖人舉事，動在萬全，百戰百勝，不若不戰而勝，若重之慎之，則契丹不足吞，燕薊不足取。

translations.literal: When the sage raises an affair, his movement lies in ten thousandfold security; a hundred battles, a hundred victories—better than victory without battle. If it is treated with weight and caution, then the Khitan are not enough to swallow and You-Ji not enough to take.
translations.idiomatic: When the sage raises an affair, his movement lies in ten thousandfold security: a hundred battles, a hundred victories—better than victory without battle. If it is treated with weight and caution, then the Khitan are not enough to swallow and You-Ji not enough to take.

sentences.zh: 自古疆埸之難，非盡由敵國，亦多邊吏擾而致之。

translations.literal: Since antiquity the difficulties of the frontier have not all come from enemy states; many also come from frontier officials harassing and causing them.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity the difficulties of the frontier have not all come from enemy states; many also come from frontier officials harassing and causing them.

sentences.zh: 若緣邊諸砦撫御得人，但使峻壘深溝，畜力養銳，以逸自處，寧我致人，此李牧所以用趙也。

translations.literal: If along the border the various forts are governed and controlled with the right men, so that steep ramparts and deep moats are maintained, strength is stored and keen edge nurtured, and ease is taken as one's position—better to let me strike at others—this is how Li Mu used Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: If along the border the various forts are governed and controlled with the right men, so that steep ramparts and deep moats are maintained, strength is stored and keen edge nurtured, and ease is taken as one's position—better to let me strike at others—this is how Li Mu used Zhao.

sentences.zh: 所謂擇卒不如擇將，任力不如任人。

translations.literal: What is said is: choosing soldiers is not as good as choosing generals; relying on force is not as good as relying on men.
translations.idiomatic: What is said is: choosing soldiers is not as good as choosing generals; relying on force is not as good as relying on men.

sentences.zh: 如是則邊鄙寧，邊鄙寧則輦運減，輦運減則河北之民獲休息矣。

translations.literal: If so, then the border marches are tranquil; if the border marches are tranquil, then transport is reduced; if transport is reduced, then the people of Hebei obtain rest.
translations.idiomatic: If so, then the border marches are tranquil; if the border marches are tranquil, then transport is reduced; if transport is reduced, then the people of Hebei obtain rest.

sentences.zh: 民獲休息，則田業增而蠶績廣，務農積穀，以實邊用。

translations.literal: When the people obtain rest, then field enterprise increases and silkworm work expands; devote effort to farming and accumulate grain to fill border use.
translations.idiomatic: When the people obtain rest, field enterprise increases and silkworm work expands; devote effort to farming and accumulate grain to fill border use.

sentences.zh: 且敵人之心固亦擇利避害，安肯投諸死地而為寇哉？

translations.literal: Moreover the enemy's heart also chooses profit and avoids harm—how would they willingly cast themselves into deadly ground to become raiders?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the enemy's heart also chooses profit and avoids harm—how would they willingly cast themselves into deadly ground to become raiders?

sentences.zh: 臣聞家六合者以天下為心，豈止爭尺寸之事，角強弱之勢而已乎？

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that one who harmonizes the six directions takes all under Heaven as heart—is it only to contend over foot and inch matters and corner strong with weak?
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that one who harmonizes the six directions takes all under Heaven as heart—is it only to contend over foot and inch matters and corner strong with weak?

sentences.zh: 是故聖人先本而後末，安內以養外。

translations.literal: Therefore the sage puts root first and branch after, settles within to nourish without.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the sage puts root first and branch after, settles within to nourish without.

sentences.zh: 人民，本也，疆土，末也。

translations.literal: The people are the root; the frontier land is the branch.
translations.idiomatic: The people are the root; the frontier land is the branch.

sentences.zh: 五帝三王，未有不先根本者也。

translations.literal: The Five Emperors and Three Kings—none failed to put root first.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Emperors and Three Kings—none failed to put root first.

sentences.zh: 堯、舜之道無他，在乎安民而利之爾。

translations.literal: The way of Yao and Shun has nothing else—it lies in settling the people and benefiting them.
translations.idiomatic: The way of Yao and Shun has nothing else—it lies in settling the people and benefiting them.

sentences.zh: 民既安利，則遠人斂衽而至矣。

translations.literal: Once the people are settled and benefited, then distant men straighten their lapels and come.
translations.idiomatic: Once the people are settled and benefited, distant men straighten their lapels and come.

sentences.zh: 陛下愛民人、利天下之心，真堯、舜也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's heart that loves the people and benefits all under Heaven is truly that of Yao and Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's heart that loves the people and benefits all under Heaven is truly that of Yao and Shun.

sentences.zh: 臣慮群臣多以纖微之利，克下之術，侵苦窮民，以為功能。

translations.literal: Your servant fears that many among the ministers use minute profit and techniques for curbing subordinates, oppressing and distressing the poor people, and regard this as achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant fears that many among the ministers use minute profit and techniques for curbing subordinates, oppressing and distressing the poor people, and regard this as achievement.

sentences.zh: 至於生民疾苦，見之如不見，聞之如不聞，斂怨速尤，無大於此。

translations.literal: As for the people's hardships—seeing them as if not seen, hearing them as if not heard, gathering resentment and hastening blame—nothing is greater than this.
translations.idiomatic: As for the people's hardships—seeing them as if not seen, hearing them as if not heard, gathering resentment and hastening blame—nothing is greater than this.

sentences.zh: 伏望慎擇通儒，分路采訪兩浙、江南、荊湖、西川、嶺南、河東，凡前日賦斂苛重者，改而正之，因而利之，使賦稅課利通濟，可經久而行，為聖朝定法；

translations.literal: Your servant humbly hopes that learned Confucians will be carefully chosen and sent by separate routes to investigate Liang-Zhe, Jiangnan, Jing-Hu, Xichuan, Lingnan, and Hedong; wherever former levies and exactions were harsh, change and correct them, and thereby benefit the people, so that taxes and commercial profits are well regulated and may be carried on for long—establishing the sage dynasty's fixed law;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant humbly hopes that learned Confucians will be carefully chosen and sent by separate routes to investigate Liang-Zhe, Jiangnan, Jing-Hu, Xichuan, Lingnan, and Hedong. Wherever former levies and exactions were harsh, change and correct them, and thereby benefit the people, so that taxes and commercial profits are well regulated and may be carried on for long, establishing the sage dynasty's fixed law;

sentences.zh: 除去舊弊，天下諸州有不便於民者，委長吏以聞。

translations.literal: remove old abuses; throughout the empire, wherever any prefecture has what is not convenient for the people, let the chief official report it.
translations.idiomatic: remove old abuses. Throughout the empire, wherever any prefecture has what is not convenient for the people, let the chief official report it.

sentences.zh: 敢循故常者，重置之法。

translations.literal: Whoever dares follow the old routine—heavy penalties by law.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever dares follow the old routine—heavy penalties by law.

sentences.zh: 使天下耳目皆知陛下之心，戴陛下之惠，以德懷遠，以惠利民，則遠人之歸，可立而待也。」

translations.literal: Let all under Heaven's ears and eyes know Your Majesty's heart and bear Your Majesty's grace; with virtue embrace the distant and with favor benefit the people—then the return of distant men may be awaited standing."
translations.idiomatic: Let all under Heaven's ears and eyes know Your Majesty's heart and bear Your Majesty's grace. With virtue embrace the distant and with favor benefit the people, then the return of distant men may be awaited standing."

sentences.zh: 六年，為江南西路轉運副使，冬，改右補闕，加正使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was made Vice Transport Commissioner of the Jiangnan West Circuit; in winter he was changed to Right Reminder and made chief commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made Vice Transport Commissioner of the Jiangnan West Circuit. In winter he was changed to Right Reminder and made chief commissioner.

sentences.zh: 齊賢至官，詢知饒、信、虔州土產銅、鐵、鉛、錫之所，推求前代鑄法，取饒州永平監所鑄以為定式，歲鑄五十萬貫，凡用銅八十五萬斤，鉛三十六萬斤，錫十六萬斤，詣闕面陳其事，敷奏詳確，議者不能奪。

translations.literal: When Qixian reached his post he inquired and learned where in Rao, Xin, and Qian prefectures copper, iron, lead, and tin were produced; he sought out former casting methods, took the Yongping Directorate of Rao Prefecture as the fixed model, and cast five hundred thousand strings annually, using in all eight hundred fifty thousand jin of copper, three hundred sixty thousand jin of lead, and one hundred sixty thousand jin of tin. He went to court and presented the matter in person; his exposition was detailed and exact, and the discussants could not overturn it.
translations.idiomatic: When Qixian reached his post he learned where Rao, Xin, and Qian produced copper, iron, lead, and tin, sought out former casting methods, and took the Yongping Directorate of Rao as the fixed model, casting five hundred thousand strings annually with eight hundred fifty thousand jin of copper, three hundred sixty thousand jin of lead, and one hundred sixty thousand jin of tin. He presented the matter at court in person; his exposition was detailed and exact, and the discussants could not overturn it.

sentences.zh: 先是，諸州罪人多錮送闕下，路死者十常五六。

translations.literal: Previously, criminals from the various prefectures were mostly shackled and sent to court; of those on the road, five or six in ten commonly died.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, criminals from the various prefectures were mostly shackled and sent to court; of those on the road, five or six in ten commonly died.

sentences.zh: 齊賢道逢南劍、建昌、虔州所送，索牒視之，率非首犯，悉伸其冤抑。

translations.literal: Qixian on the road encountered those sent from Nanjian, Jianchang, and Qian prefectures, demanded their documents and examined them, found that for the most part they were not chief culprits, and fully redressed their wrongful oppression.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian on the road encountered prisoners sent from Nanjian, Jianchang, and Qian, demanded their documents and examined them, found that for the most part they were not chief culprits, and fully redressed their wrongful oppression.

sentences.zh: 因力言於朝，後凡送囚至京，請委強明吏慮問，不實，則罪及原問官屬。

translations.literal: Thereupon he spoke forcefully to the court; afterward, whenever prisoners were sent to the capital, the court was asked to entrust them to strong and clear officials for reconsideration, and if not substantiated, then guilt would reach the original examining officials.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he spoke forcefully to the court. Afterward, whenever prisoners were sent to the capital, the court was asked to entrust them to strong and clear officials for reconsideration, and if not substantiated, guilt would reach the original examining officials.

sentences.zh: 自是江南送罪人者為減太半。

translations.literal: From this, those sending criminals from Jiangnan were reduced by more than half.
translations.idiomatic: From this, those sending criminals from Jiangnan were reduced by more than half.

sentences.zh: 先是，江南諸州小民，居官地者有地房錢，吉州緣江地雖淪沒，猶納勾欄地錢，編木而浮居者名水場錢，皆前代弊政，齊賢悉論免之。

translations.literal: Previously, among the common people of Jiangnan's various prefectures, those dwelling on official land paid ground-rent for housing; in Ji Prefecture, though riverbank land had been submerged, they still paid railing-ground money; those who wove wood and lived afloat were called water-station money—all abuses of former dynasties, which Qixian fully memorialized to exempt.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, among common people of Jiangnan's prefectures, those dwelling on official land paid ground-rent for housing. In Ji Prefecture, though riverbank land had been submerged, they still paid railing-ground money. Those who wove wood and lived afloat paid water-station money. All were abuses of former dynasties, which Qixian fully memorialized to exempt.

sentences.zh: 初，李氏據有江南，民戶稅錢三千已上者戶出丁一人，黥面，自備器甲輸官庫，出即給之，日支糧二升，名為義軍。

translations.literal: Initially, when the Li clan held Jiangnan, households whose tax money reached three thousand or above furnished one man per household, tattooed the face, and supplied armor and weapons themselves to deliver to the government storehouse; on going out they were issued, with two sheng of grain daily support—called Righteous Army.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when the Li clan held Jiangnan, households whose tax money reached three thousand or above furnished one man per household, tattooed the face, and supplied armor and weapons themselves to deliver to the government storehouse. On going out they were issued arms, with two sheng of grain daily support, called the Righteous Army.

sentences.zh: 既內附，皆放歸農。

translations.literal: After they submitted inward, all were released to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: After they submitted inward, all were released to return to farming.

sentences.zh: 至是，言者以為此輩久在行伍，不樂耕農，乞遣使選充軍伍，並其家屬送闕下。

translations.literal: At this time memorialists held that this host had long been in the ranks and did not delight in farming, and begged that envoys be sent to select them to fill military companies and send their families to court.
translations.idiomatic: At this time memorialists held that this host had long been in the ranks and did not delight in farming, and begged that envoys be sent to select them to fill military companies and send their families to court.

sentences.zh: 齊賢上言：「江南義軍，例皆良民，橫遭黥配，無所逃避。

translations.literal: Qixian submitted: "The Jiangnan Righteous Army were in every case good common people, forcibly tattooed and assigned, with nowhere to escape.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian submitted, "The Jiangnan Righteous Army were in every case good common people, forcibly tattooed and assigned, with nowhere to escape.

sentences.zh: 克復之後，便放歸農，久被皇風，並皆樂業。

translations.literal: After recovery they were at once released to return to farming; long bathed in imperial wind, all have been content in their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: After recovery they were at once released to return to farming. Long bathed in imperial wind, all have been content in their occupations.

sentences.zh: 若逐戶搜索，不無驚擾。

translations.literal: If household by household they are searched out, there will be no lack of alarm and disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: If household by household they are searched out, there will be no lack of alarm and disturbance.

sentences.zh: 法貴有常，政尚清淨，前敕既放營農，不若且仍舊貫。

translations.literal: Law values constancy; government esteems purity and quietness. Since the former edict already released them to camp farming, better to let the old practice stand."
translations.idiomatic: Law values constancy; government esteems purity and quietness. Since the former edict already released them to camp farming, better to let the old practice stand."

sentences.zh: 」齊賢居使職，勤究民弊，務行寬大，江左人思之不忘。

translations.literal: Qixian in his commissioner post diligently investigated the people's abuses and strove to practice leniency and breadth; the people of the Jiang left remember him without forgetting.
translations.idiomatic: In his commissioner post Qixian diligently investigated the people's abuses and strove to practice leniency and breadth; the people of the Jiang left remember him without forgetting.

sentences.zh: 召還，拜樞密直學士，擢右諫議大夫、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Recalled, he was appointed Direct Academician of the Privy Council, promoted to Right Remonstrator and Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he was appointed Direct Academician of the Privy Council, promoted to Right Remonstrator and Commissioner of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 雍熙初，遷左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi he was transferred to Left Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongxi he was transferred to Left Remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 三年，大舉北伐，代州楊業戰沒。

translations.literal: In the third year a great northern campaign was launched; Yang Ye of Dai Prefecture was killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year a great northern campaign was launched; Yang Ye of Dai Prefecture was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 上訪近臣以策，齊賢請行，即授給事中、知代州，與部署潘美同領緣邊兵馬。

translations.literal: The emperor consulted nearby ministers for strategy; Qixian requested to go and was at once made Supervising Secretary and prefect of Dai Prefecture, jointly leading frontier troops and horses with Deployment Commissioner Pan Mei.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted nearby ministers for strategy. Qixian requested to go and was at once made Supervising Secretary and prefect of Dai Prefecture, jointly leading frontier troops and horses with Deployment Commissioner Pan Mei.

sentences.zh: 是時遼兵自湖谷入寇，薄城下，神衛都校馬正以所部列南門外，眾寡不敵，副部署盧漢贇畏懦，保壁自固。

translations.literal: At that time Liao troops entered from Hugu Valley to raid and pressed below the city wall. Shenwei Commander Ma Zheng arrayed his command outside the south gate; the multitude was few and could not match them. Vice Deployment Commissioner Lu Hanyun was timid and cowardly, protecting the walls and holding himself firm.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liao troops entered from Hugu Valley to raid and pressed below the city wall. Shenwei Commander Ma Zheng arrayed his command outside the south gate, but the multitude was few and could not match them. Vice Deployment Commissioner Lu Hanyun was timid and cowardly, protecting the walls and holding himself firm.

sentences.zh: 齊賢選廂軍二千，出正之右，誓眾慷慨，一以當百，遼兵遂卻。

translations.literal: Qixian selected two thousand garrison troops, went out to Zheng's right, and swore to the multitude with generous ardor—one against a hundred—and the Liao troops then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian selected two thousand garrison troops, went out to Zheng's right, and swore to the multitude with generous ardor—one against a hundred—and the Liao troops then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 先是，約潘美以幷師來會戰，無何，間使為遼人所得。

translations.literal: Previously, it had been agreed that Pan Mei would bring Bing troops to join battle; before long, a secret envoy was captured by the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, it had been agreed that Pan Mei would bring Bing troops to join battle. Before long, a secret envoy was captured by the Liao.

sentences.zh: 齊賢以師期既漏，且虞美眾為遼所乘。

translations.literal: Qixian, because the army rendezvous had leaked and he also feared Mei's force would be caught by the Liao—
translations.idiomatic: Qixian, because the army rendezvous had leaked, also feared Mei's force would be caught by the Liao.

sentences.zh: 既而美使至，云師出并州，至柏井，得密詔，東師敗績於君子館，幷之全軍不許出戰，已還州矣。

translations.literal: then Mei's envoy arrived, saying the army had left Bing Prefecture and reached Baijing, received a secret edict: the eastern army had been defeated at Junzi Lodge, and Bing's entire army was not permitted to go out to battle and had already returned to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Then Mei's envoy arrived, saying the army had left Bing Prefecture and reached Baijing, received a secret edict: the eastern army had been defeated at Junzi Lodge, and Bing's entire army was not permitted to go out to battle and had already returned to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 於時遼兵塞川，齊賢曰：「賊知美之來，而不知美之退。

translations.literal: At that time Liao troops blocked the valleys. Qixian said: "The bandits know Mei is coming but do not know Mei has withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liao troops blocked the valleys. Qixian said, "The bandits know Mei is coming but do not know Mei has withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 」乃閉其使密室，中夜發兵二百，人持一幟，負一束芻，距州城西南三十里，列幟然芻。

translations.literal: " He then shut the envoy in a secret room; at midnight he sent out two hundred troops, each holding one banner and bearing one bundle of straw, thirty li southwest of the prefectural city, where they arrayed banners and lit the straw.
translations.idiomatic: " He then shut the envoy in a secret room. At midnight he sent out two hundred troops, each holding one banner and bearing one bundle of straw, thirty li southwest of the prefectural city, where they arrayed banners and lit the straw.

sentences.zh: 遼兵遙見火光中有旗幟，意謂幷師至矣，駭而北走。

translations.literal: From afar the Liao troops saw banners amid the firelight and thought Bing troops had arrived; startled, they fled north.
translations.idiomatic: From afar the Liao troops saw banners amid the firelight and thought Bing troops had arrived. Startled, they fled north.

sentences.zh: 齊賢先伏步兵二千於土磴砦，掩擊大敗之，擒其北大王之子一人，帳前錫利一人，斬數百級，獲馬二千、器甲甚眾。

translations.literal: Qixian had first hidden two thousand foot soldiers at Tudeng Fort, ambushed them, and inflicted a great defeat, capturing one son of their Northern Great King, one Xili before the tent, beheading several hundred heads, and obtaining two thousand horses and very many weapons and armor.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian had first hidden two thousand foot soldiers at Tudeng Fort, ambushed them, and inflicted a great defeat, capturing one son of their Northern Great King, one Xili before the tent, beheading several hundred heads, and obtaining two thousand horses and very many weapons and armor.

sentences.zh: 捷奏，且歸功漢贇。

translations.literal: He reported victory and moreover attributed merit to Hanyun.
translations.idiomatic: He reported victory and moreover attributed merit to Hanyun.

sentences.zh: 二年，置屯田，領河東制置方田都部署，入拜刑部侍郎、樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the second year garrison fields were established; he headed the Hedong Directorate for Garrison Fields and Rectified Fields, entered court as Vice Minister of Justice and Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year garrison fields were established. He headed the Hedong Directorate for Garrison Fields and Rectified Fields and entered court as Vice Minister of Justice and Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年夏，參知政事，數月，拜吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua, summer, he became Participant in Governance; several months later he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Chief Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunhua, summer, he became Participant in Governance. Several months later he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Chief Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 齊賢母孫氏年八十餘，封晉國太夫人，每入謁禁中，上歎其福壽、有令子，多手詔存問，加賜與，搢紳榮之。

translations.literal: Qixian's mother, the Sun clan, was over eighty; she was enfeoffed Lady of Jin. Whenever she entered the forbidden precincts the emperor sighed at her fortune and longevity and worthy son, often writing edicts in his own hand to inquire after her, adding gifts—officialdom regarded this as glory.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian's mother, the Sun clan, was over eighty and was enfeoffed Lady of Jin. Whenever she entered the forbidden precincts the emperor sighed at her fortune and longevity and worthy son, often writing edicts in his own hand to inquire after her and adding gifts—officialdom regarded this as glory.

sentences.zh: 初，王延德與朱貽業同掌京庾，欲求補外，貽業與參政李沆有姻婭，託之以請於沆，沆為請於齊賢，齊賢以聞。

translations.literal: Initially, Wang Yande and Zhu Yiye jointly managed the capital granaries and wished to obtain an outside posting. Yiye had a marriage tie with Participant in Governance Li Hang and entrusted him to request it of Hang; Hang requested it of Qixian, and Qixian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Wang Yande and Zhu Yiye jointly managed the capital granaries and wished to obtain an outside posting. Yiye had a marriage tie with Participant in Governance Li Hang and entrusted him to request it of Hang. Hang requested it of Qixian, and Qixian reported it.

sentences.zh: 太宗以延德嘗事晉邸。

translations.literal: Taizong, because Yande had once served the Jin princely establishment—
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, because Yande had once served the Jin princely establishment,

sentences.zh: 怒其不自陳而干祈執政，召見詰責。

translations.literal: was angry that he had not stated it himself but importuned the chief councilor, summoned him and interrogated and reproached him.
translations.idiomatic: was angry that he had not stated it himself but importuned the chief councilor, summoned him, and interrogated and reproached him.

sentences.zh: 延德、貽業皆諱不以實對，齊賢不欲累沆，獨任其責。

translations.literal: Yande and Yiye both concealed and did not answer with the truth; Qixian did not wish to implicate Hang and alone bore the blame.
translations.idiomatic: Yande and Yiye both concealed and did not answer with the truth. Qixian did not wish to implicate Hang and alone bore the blame.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，罷為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year he was demoted to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year he was demoted to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月，命知定州，以母老不願往，未幾，丁內艱，水漿不入口者七日，自是日啖粥一器，終喪不食酒肉蔬果。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was ordered to be prefect of Ding Prefecture; because his mother was old he did not wish to go. Before long he entered mourning for his mother; for seven days he would not take water or broth, and from then ate one bowl of gruel daily; through the mourning he did not eat wine, meat, or vegetables and fruits.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was ordered to be prefect of Ding Prefecture, but because his mother was old he did not wish to go. Before long he entered mourning for his mother. For seven days he would not take water or broth, and from then ate one bowl of gruel daily. Through the mourning he did not eat wine, meat, or vegetables and fruits.

sentences.zh: 尋復轉禮部尚書、知河南府。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was again made Minister of Rites and prefect of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was again made Minister of Rites and prefect of Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時獄有大辟將決，齊賢至，立辨而釋之。

translations.literal: At the time a great capital offense in the prisons was about to be decided; when Qixian arrived he immediately distinguished and released them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a great capital offense in the prisons was about to be decided. When Qixian arrived he immediately distinguished and released them.

sentences.zh: 三日，徙知永興軍。

translations.literal: Three days later he was transferred to prefect of Yongxing Army.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later he was transferred to prefect of Yongxing Army.

sentences.zh: 時閣門祗候趙讚以言事得幸，提點關中芻糧，所為多豪橫。

translations.literal: At the time Palace Gate Attendant Zhao Zan, through memorializing on affairs, had gained favor and was made intendant of Guanzhong fodder and grain; his conduct was largely overbearing.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Palace Gate Attendant Zhao Zan, through memorializing on affairs, had gained favor and was made intendant of Guanzhong fodder and grain. His conduct was largely overbearing.

sentences.zh: 齊賢論列其罪，卒抵於法。

translations.literal: Qixian memorialized listing his crimes, and in the end he was brought to law.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian memorialized listing his crimes, and in the end he was brought to law.

sentences.zh: 俄徙襄州，移荊南，又徙安州。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Xiang Prefecture, moved to Jingnan, and again to An Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Xiang Prefecture, moved to Jingnan, and again to An Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 逾年，加刑部尚書。

translations.literal: After a year he was given the additional title Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was given the additional title Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 四年，李繼遷陷清遠軍，命為涇、原等州軍安撫經略使，以右司諫梁顥為之副。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Li Jiqian took Qingyuan Army; he was appointed Pacification and Frontier Commissioner of Jing, Yuan, and other prefectures, with Right Remonstrator Liang Hao as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Li Jiqian took Qingyuan Army. He was appointed Pacification and Frontier Commissioner of Jing, Yuan, and other prefectures, with Right Remonstrator Liang Hao as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 齊賢上言謂：「清遠軍陷沒以來，青岡砦燒棄之後，靈武一郡，援隔勢孤，此繼遷之所覬覦而必至者也。

translations.literal: Qixian submitted saying: "Since Qingyuan Army fell, after Qinggang Fort was burned and abandoned, the single commandery of Lingwu, cut off in support and isolated in strength—this is what Jiqian covets and is certain to reach.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian submitted saying, "Since Qingyuan Army fell, after Qinggang Fort was burned and abandoned, the single commandery of Lingwu, cut off in support and isolated in strength—this is what Jiqian covets and is certain to reach.

sentences.zh: 以事勢言之，加討則不足，防遏則有餘。

translations.literal: Speaking by the trend of affairs, to attack further is insufficient, but to defend and block is more than enough.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking by the trend of affairs, to attack further is insufficient, but to defend and block is more than enough.

sentences.zh: 其計無他，蕃部大族首領素與繼遷有隙者，若能啖以官爵，誘以貨利，結之以恩信，而激之以利害，則山西之蕃部族帳，靡不傾心朝廷矣。

translations.literal: The plan is nothing else: among the great tribal chiefs of the Fan, those who by nature have rifts with Jiqian—if they can be fed with titles and enfeoffments, enticed with goods and profit, bound with favor and trust, and stirred with benefit and harm—then the tribal tents of the Fan in the western mountains will none fail to turn their hearts to the court.
translations.idiomatic: The plan is nothing else. Among the great tribal chiefs of the Fan, those who by nature have rifts with Jiqian—if they can be fed with titles and enfeoffments, enticed with goods and profit, bound with favor and trust, and stirred with benefit and harm—then the tribal tents of the Fan in the western mountains will none fail to turn their hearts to the court.

sentences.zh: 臣所領十二州軍，見二萬餘人，若緣邊料柬本城等軍，更得五萬餘人，招致蕃部，其數又逾十數萬。

translations.literal: The twelve prefectural armies your servant leads presently see more than twenty thousand men; if along the border the native troops of the prefectural cities and the like are further mustered, another fifty thousand-odd may be obtained, and if Fan tribes are recruited, their number again exceeds one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve prefectural armies your servant leads presently see more than twenty thousand men. If along the border the native troops of the prefectural cities and the like are further mustered, another fifty thousand-odd may be obtained, and if Fan tribes are recruited, their number again exceeds one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 但彼出則我歸，東備則西擊，使之奔走不暇，何能為我患哉？

translations.literal: Only when they go out we return, when they prepare east we strike west—make them run without rest; how can they become a trouble to us?
translations.idiomatic: Only when they go out we return, when they prepare east we strike west—make them run without rest. How can they become a trouble to us?

sentences.zh: 今靈武軍民不翅六七萬，陷於危亡之地，若繼遷來春於我兵未舉之前，發兵救援靈武，盡驅其眾，並力攻圍，則靈州孤城必難固守。

translations.literal: Now the troops and people of Lingwu are no fewer than sixty or seventy thousand, trapped in a place of peril and death. If Jiqian next spring, before our troops are raised, sends troops to rescue Lingwu, drives out all its multitude, and with combined strength attacks and besieges, then Ling Prefecture's lone city will surely be hard to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Now the troops and people of Lingwu are no fewer than sixty or seventy thousand, trapped in a place of peril and death. If Jiqian next spring, before our troops are raised, sends troops to rescue Lingwu, drives out all its multitude, and with combined strength attacks and besieges, then Ling Prefecture's lone city will surely be hard to hold firm.

sentences.zh: 萬一失陷，賊勢益增，縱多聚甲兵，廣積財貨，亦難保必勝矣。

translations.literal: In the event of ten thousand to one that it falls, the bandit power will increase all the more; even if many armor and troops are gathered and wealth and goods widely stored, it will still be hard to guarantee certain victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the event of ten thousand to one that it falls, the bandit power will increase all the more. Even if many armor and troops are gathered and wealth and goods widely stored, it will still be hard to guarantee certain victory.

sentences.zh: 臣所以乞封潘羅支為六谷王而厚以金帛者，恐繼遷旦暮用兵斷彼賣馬之路也。

translations.literal: The reason your servant begged to enfeoff Pan Luozhi as King of the Six Valleys and reward him thickly with gold and silks is that he feared Jiqian might at any time use troops and cut off their horse-selling road.
translations.idiomatic: The reason your servant begged to enfeoff Pan Luozhi as King of the Six Valleys and reward him thickly with gold and silks is that he feared Jiqian might at any time use troops and cut off their horse-selling road.

sentences.zh: 苟朝廷信使得達潘羅支，則泥埋等族、西南遠蕃，不難招集。

translations.literal: If the court's trust-envoy can reach Pan Luozhi, then the Nimi and other tribes and the distant Fan of the southwest are not hard to gather.
translations.idiomatic: If the court's trust-envoy can reach Pan Luozhi, then the Nimi and other tribes and the distant Fan of the southwest are not hard to gather.

sentences.zh: 西南既禀命，而緣邊之勢張，則鄜、延、環、慶之淺蕃，原、渭、鎮戎之熟戶，自然歸化。

translations.literal: Once the southwest has received orders and the border power is extended, then the shallow Fan of Bian, Yan, Huan, and Qing, and the registered households of Yuan, Wei, and Zhenrong, will naturally submit.
